title: The Preemie-Test for Assessment of Newborn Skin Maturity
author: Zilma Reis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7ynhpve

steps.title: Prepare the newborn for examination
steps.instruction: Expose the newborn's foot gently without raising the lower limb or handling the newborn; perform the exam where the child is being cared for (e.g., inside the incubator, warm crib, or mother's lap).

steps.title: Identify the skin assessment site
steps.instruction: Locate the central area of the posterior portion of the sole of the foot by imagining two diagonal lines running through the sole region and choosing the point where they meet.

steps.title: Position the sensor
steps.instruction: Touch the sensor to the skin perpendicularly at a 90-degree angle.

steps.title: Perform the assessment
steps.instruction: Execute the test by following the messages on the Preemie-Test display, repeating the assessment three times at the same site on the foot skin.
